    <span class="faqQuestionText">Are members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints Christian?</span>
    <span class="faqChevron" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="faqChevronClosed"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
      <span class="faqChevronOpen"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-up" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 15l-6-6-6 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
    </span>
  </summary>
  <div class="faqAnswer"><p>Yes! As members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, we believe <a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/savior-jesus-christ?lang=eng">Jesus Christ</a> is the Son of God and the Savior of the World. He loves us all more than we can imagine. We consider ourselves devoted followers of Jesus. While some of our beliefs are distinct, we believe that through His life, ministry, sacrifice, and resurrection, Jesus Christ saves us from sin, suffering, and death.</p><p>Learn more about our <a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/what-do-latter-day-saints-believe?lang=eng">beliefs</a>.</p></div>
</details>
<details class="faqItem" >
  <summary class="faqQuestion" data-analytics-location="Common Questions" data-analytics-name="What are Church services like?" data-analytics-lang="eng" onclick="if(window.digitalData&&window.digitalDataEvents){var d=this.dataset;window.digitalData.push({event:window.digitalDataEvents.component.click,component:{info:{location:d.analyticsLocation,name:d.analyticsName,language:d.analyticsLang},category:{primary:'accordion'},content:{stakeholder:'CCD'}}});}">
    <span class="faqQuestionText">What are Church services like?</span>
    <span class="faqChevron" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="faqChevronClosed"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
      <span class="faqChevronOpen"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-up" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 15l-6-6-6 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
    </span>
  </summary>
  <div class="faqAnswer"><p>Church service times vary from congregation to congregation. However, you can always count on one main worship service for everyone, followed by classes for children, youth, and adults.</p><p>The service for everyone is called “sacrament meeting.” This meeting consists of songs, prayers, and sermons (or “talks”) given by different members of the congregation every week. But the most important part of the meeting is when we take the sacrament (which is similar to communion) to remember the Savior.</p><p>Learn more about <a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/what-to-expect?lang=eng">Sunday services</a> or <a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/find-a-church?lang=eng">find a church</a> near you.</p></div>
</details>
<details class="faqItem" >
  <summary class="faqQuestion" data-analytics-location="Common Questions" data-analytics-name="Why does The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints have temples?" data-analytics-lang="eng" onclick="if(window.digitalData&&window.digitalDataEvents){var d=this.dataset;window.digitalData.push({event:window.digitalDataEvents.component.click,component:{info:{location:d.analyticsLocation,name:d.analyticsName,language:d.analyticsLang},category:{primary:'accordion'},content:{stakeholder:'CCD'}}});}">
    <span class="faqQuestionText">Why does The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints have temples?</span>
    <span class="faqChevron" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="faqChevronClosed"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
      <span class="faqChevronOpen"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-up" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 15l-6-6-6 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
    </span>
  </summary>
  <div class="faqAnswer"><p>For Latter-day Saints, a <a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/temples-bind-us?lang=eng">temple</a> is different from other Church buildings. The temple is a place where Latter-day Saints receive special instruction about God and Jesus Christ. In the temple, members make eternal covenants (or promises) with God. This includes promises to keep the commandments, live the gospel of Jesus Christ, be faithful in marriage, and to help take care of each other by sharing what we have. </p><p>Also, because we believe <a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/families-together-forever?lang=eng">families are forever</a>, much of the work done inside temples is to make family bonds even stronger. Marriages in the temple are performed to last eternally, not just “until death do you part.” Parents and children become eternal families in temples. Ancestors can also receive all the blessings of the temple if someone performs the sacred ordinances in their behalf and they accept that act of service. Temples are busy places!</p></div>
</details>
<details class="faqItem" >
  <summary class="faqQuestion" data-analytics-location="Common Questions" data-analytics-name="What is the Book of Mormon?" data-analytics-lang="eng" onclick="if(window.digitalData&&window.digitalDataEvents){var d=this.dataset;window.digitalData.push({event:window.digitalDataEvents.component.click,component:{info:{location:d.analyticsLocation,name:d.analyticsName,language:d.analyticsLang},category:{primary:'accordion'},content:{stakeholder:'CCD'}}});}">
    <span class="faqQuestionText">What is the Book of Mormon?</span>
    <span class="faqChevron" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="faqChevronClosed"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
      <span class="faqChevronOpen"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-up" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 15l-6-6-6 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
    </span>
  </summary>
  <div class="faqAnswer"><p><a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/bible-book-of-mormon-word-of-god?lang=eng">The Book of Mormon</a> is a book of inspired scripture that teaches us about God and Jesus Christ. It helps us receive direction for our personal lives and can help us feel closer to Jesus Christ. Where does the name come from? Hundreds of years ago, an ancient prophet named Mormon compiled a record of his people. They faced a lot of the same challenges that we do. And just like us, they found strength when they turned to Jesus Christ. <a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/meet-with-missionaries?lang=eng">Get an introduction to the Book of Mormon with missionaries</a>.</p><p>The Book of Mormon stands alongside the Bible as another testament of Jesus Christ and His divine mission as the Savior and Redeemer of the world. Together, the Bible and the Book of Mormon provide more understanding of God’s great love for all of us and can help us come closer to Him. </p><p>Learn more about <a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/bible-book-of-mormon-word-of-god?lang=eng">how the Bible and Book of Mormon work together</a>.</p></div>
</details>
<details class="faqItem" >
  <summary class="faqQuestion" data-analytics-location="Common Questions" data-analytics-name="Do we believe in the Bible?" data-analytics-lang="eng" onclick="if(window.digitalData&&window.digitalDataEvents){var d=this.dataset;window.digitalData.push({event:window.digitalDataEvents.component.click,component:{info:{location:d.analyticsLocation,name:d.analyticsName,language:d.analyticsLang},category:{primary:'accordion'},content:{stakeholder:'CCD'}}});}">
    <span class="faqQuestionText">Do we believe in the Bible?</span>
    <span class="faqChevron" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="faqChevronClosed"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
      <span class="faqChevronOpen"><svg class="icon icon-chevron-up" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 15l-6-6-6 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></span>
    </span>
  </summary>
  <div class="faqAnswer"><p>Yes. The Bible is the word of God, a sacred volume of scripture, and following its teachings brings joy to our lives. Along with the Bible, we also find inspiration in other books of scripture unique to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. They all work together to teach us important truths about God and Jesus Christ.</p><p>Learn more about our belief in <a href="https://www.churchofjesuschrist.org/welcome/bible-book-of-mormon-word-of-god?lang=eng">the Bible</a>.</p></div>
</details>
